anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the barrel jack J10 has its electrical pins 2 and 3 wired onto the BAT+ input rail (the same node as J10.1 / NET0020), and the only connection to GND on the symbol is the mounting holes MH1/MH2. The sleeve contact (pin 2) is therefore not on GND and the switch contact (pin 3) is not on BAT-.
anomalies.expected: The specification's intended (rev D) wiring is 'J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-'. With pins 2 and 3 normally shorted (per the in-sheet note), this keeps the battery return tied to GND by default and breaks it when a plug is inserted. Pin 2 must be GND and pin 3 must be BAT-, not BAT+.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch (page 7): text note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive'; J10 pins 1,2,3 all terminate on the BAT+ rail (NET0020), with GND reached only via MH1/MH2 mounting holes.
Netlist: J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-. ... inserting a DC plug breaks that short — disconnecting the battery.
commit a1d9676 'Meshinger 1.0 rev B WARNING THE DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY!'

anomalies.impact: Because the sleeve pin (2) is tied to BAT+ instead of GND, inserting a DC adapter (whose sleeve is ground) shorts BAT+ to ground, shorting the cell/adapter — exactly the documented rev‑B 'SHORTS BATTERY' condition. In addition, with pin 3 on BAT+ rather than BAT-, the jack's internal switch cannot disconnect the battery (the cell negative is hard-tied to GND elsewhere), so the intended power-switch function is lost.

parsed.summary: The build is largely a faithful, renumbered copy of the spec (SKW92A, BBQ10KBD, FH34SRJ‑24S, MCH3478, SS2040FL×3, NTR2101P, FAN53610AUC33X, 10 µH/0.47 Ω/1 µF‑6.3 V EPD values all present and correct), but the DC barrel jack J10's sleeve and switch contacts are wired onto the BAT+ rail instead of GND and BAT-, reintroducing the documented 'DC plug pins are wrong, shorts battery' fault.
